title: Roundtables: A Conversation With the Creator of AI-Designed Viruses
key_facts: MIT Technology Review will host a live Roundtables conversation on 16 Oct 2026 at 18:30 BST.
Speakers: AI reporter James O'Donnell and Samuel King, a bioengineering PhD candidate at Stanford University and the Arc Institute.
In 2025 King used a generative AI model to propose genetic blueprints for microscopic viruses.
The page says this is not yet an example of AI-generated life, but that could be next.
King was named one of MIT Technology Review's Innovators Under 35.
quote_evidence: In 2025, Stanford University PhD student Samuel King came up with a preliminary answer when he used a generative AI model to propose genetic blueprints for microscopic viruses.
It isn’t yet an example of AI-generated life, but that could be next.
